name: Rottenroots
source:
In this haunting visual novel, you become Salem - torn between forbidden love and regime loyalty. Make split-second decisions that transform his personality in a solarpunk dystopia. With multiple paths and endings, your choices define who Salem becomes in a world where being different is dangerous. 

Characters remember your actions and evolve alongside your choices. Betray a friend, and they'll never look at you the same way. Show unexpected kindness, and enemies might become allies. Your relationships transform with each playthrough, creating a truly personalized experience every time.

When the clock starts ticking, your instincts reveal who you truly are. Face tense moments where hesitation means death, and split-second decisions determine who lives and who dies. For fans of emotionally charged narratives with real consequences, Rottenroots delivers the adrenaline rush of genuine moral dilemmas.

In a solarpunk world corrupted by evil, the line between utopia and nightmare blurs with each passing day. As Salem navigates a society where conformity means survival, every secret harbored is another root growing deeper. Experience a world where technology and nature intertwine, and resistance blooms in unexpected places.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3177730/Rottenroots/]Steam[/url]]
